name: Tuscan Bean Soup
steps: Heat the oil and cook onion, carrot and celery for 6 minutes. Add garlic and herbs.
Add tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the beans and stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Mash a few beans against the side of the pot to thicken the broth.
Add the greens and cook for 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
note: A rustic Tuscan-style soup; no cheese rind is used, so it stays vegan.
